pen_type.description: LCD line pattern selector such as SOLID or DOTTED.

text_flags.description: Text rendering flags used by legacy LCD number APIs.

lcd_color_RGB565.description: Packed 16-bit RGB color value for color LCD APIs.

lcd_font_size.description: Font size selector such as XXLSIZE, DBLSIZE, MIDSIZE, or SMLSIZE.

lcd_text_flags.description: Bitmask of LCD text rendering flags such as INVERS, BLINK, and SHADOWED.

lcd_text_format.description: Combined LCD text formatting bitmask covering font size and text flags.

source_range_1024.description: Signed EdgeTX source value in the normalized range from -1024 to 1024.

timer_type.description: Global timer selector such as all, total, session, throttle, or throttlepct.

unit_type.description: Telemetry unit identifier from the EdgeTX unit list.

prec_type.description: Telemetry precision selector controlling decimal places.
